# Comparison task cp87-sign

The authority of checkpoint CP87, a T3.6 L4 comparison task. It is not
a Pactwright specification.

## 1. Behaviour

A sign is exactly one of the words +, plus or positive, which mean 1, or -,
minus or negative, which mean -1, in any letter case. Any other text,
including a sign word with spaces around it, is not a sign.
